FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Je m'appelle Amina.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Amina.
   B. And you?
   C. What is your name?
   D. How are you?

2. What does 'la mère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the mother
   B. the grandfather
   C. the sister
   D. the grandmother

3. What does 'la douche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the table
   C. the shower
   D. the TV

4. How do you say 'On Friday, I dance.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   B. Demain, c'est jeudi.
   C. Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.
   D. Le vendredi, je danse.

5. What does 'mardi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Sunday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Friday

6. What does 'une bougie' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a song
   B. a birthday
   C. a candle
   D. a present

7. What number is 'deux' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 5

8. What does 'une fête' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a party
   B. a birthday
   C. a present
   D. a song

9. What does 'le fromage' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cake
   B. sweets
   C. the orange
   D. cheese

10. Fill in: J'ai ______ nez. (1) (1 mark)
   A. une
   B. deux
   C. des
   D. un

11. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: Who is Njeri? (1 mark)
   A. Amina's friend
   B. Amina's mother
   C. Amina's sister
   D. Amina's grandmother

12. What does 'Qui est-ce ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my brother.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. Who is it?
   D. This is my sister.

13. What does 'Le dimanche, je me repose.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, I rest.
   B. Today it is Monday.
   C. On Sunday, I go to church.
   D. On Thursday, I sing.

14. What does 'Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   B. A week, seven days.
   C. On Sunday, I go to church.
   D. What day is it today?

15. What does 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you very much!
   B. When is your birthday?
   C. I am ten years old.
   D. My birthday is on 30 June.

16. Which little word goes with 'banane' (the banana)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. le
   D. l'

17. Which little word goes with 'ventre' (the stomach)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

18. Which little word goes with 'bras' (the arm)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

19. Which little word goes with 'pied' (the foot)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. le
   D. l'

20. What does 'Quel temps fait-il ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather like?
   B. It is snowing.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is hot.

21. Read: Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Le tapis est devant le canapé. Le chat est sous la table. Question: Where is the cat? (1 mark)
   A. under the table
   B. on the sofa
   C. behind the door
   D. in front of the sofa

22. Which little word goes with 'tapis' (the rug)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

23. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'grandfather'? (1 mark)
   A. grand-pére
   B. gran-père
   C. grand-pere
   D. grand-père

24. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'sofa'? (1 mark)
   A. caapé
   B. canapè
   C. canapé
   D. canape

25. How do you say 'the sofa' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le salon
   B. la chaise
   C. le canapé
   D. le livre

26. How do you say 'the bathroom' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la salle de bain
   B. le sac
   C. la maison
   D. la douche

27. How do you say 'the school' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'église
   B. le jour
   C. l'école
   D. la semaine

28. How do you write the number 12 in French? (1 mark)
   A. onze
   B. trois
   C. douze
   D. dix-huit

29. How do you say 'bread' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les frites
   B. le maïs
   C. le pain
   D. la carotte

30. How do you say 'next to' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à côté de
   B. tout droit
   C. à gauche
   D. à droite

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'I drink a juice.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'What is the weather like?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'There is a storm.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'The TV is in the living room.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'Here is a present for you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into French: 'I have two ears.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'Where is the key?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, je joue.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Write the French words for: the head, black, the foot (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Write a short text of three sentences in French about your week. (4 marks) (4 marks)

41. Translate into French: 'Turn right.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'On Monday, I go to school.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Quel temps fait-il ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'The cat is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'I am ten years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'You are welcome!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
